name: Vessel of Tainted Blood
summary: The Vessel of Tainted Blood is a dark vessel found in Jintha'Alor. Its foul magic empowers the Vilebranch and clouds their minds.

sections.title: Blood and Shadow
sections.body: Primal Torntusk asks you to recover these vessels from Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands. She says they carry the foul magic of the faceless blood God, empowering the Vilebranch and driving them to madness. She hopes to remove the taint and loosen the God’s grip.

faq.q: What is the Vessel of Tainted Blood?
faq.answer: It is a vessel found in Jintha'Alor that radiates foul magic tied to the faceless blood God.

faq.q: Where can I find the vessels?
faq.answer: The Vessels of Tainted Blood are found throughout Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.
Their foul magic empowers the Vilebranch and clouds their minds, driving them to madness.
Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village wants you to bring her the tainted vessels so she can remove their taint.
